description:
Mark one conversation's messages as read by the calling user.

Pass `up_to_timestamp` after reviewing a conversation so that messages
arriving in the meantime stay unread. The read mark only moves forward: a
timestamp older than the caller's current mark changes nothing. Read state
is per inbox user: this clears the unread count for the caller only, not
for other agents. The inbox also marks the messages as read on WhatsApp,
so the contact sees read receipts. Only conversations whose messages you
can read can be marked.

channel_id.description: The 360dialog channel ID of the inbox to operate on.

conversation_id.description: The conversation's contact WhatsApp ID (phone-style like '4915112345678', or business-scoped). Take it from list_conversations or search_conversations results; do not guess it.

up_to_timestamp.description: Timestamp of the last message you reviewed, taken from get_conversation results; messages up to and including it are marked read, newer ones stay unread. Omit to mark everything currently in the conversation.

name: getchat_mark_conversation_as_read
title: Mark conversation as read
